title: Braid groups are linear
abstract: The braid groups Bn can be deﬁned as the mapping class group of the n-punctured disc. The Lawrence-Krammer representation of the braid group is the induced action on a certain twisted second homology of the space C of unordered pairs of points in the n-punctured disc. Recently, Daan Krammer showed that this is a faithful representation in the case n = 4. In this paper, we show that it is faithful for all n.
